answer.diagnosis: visit_ListComp binds each item and unconditionally appends the element, ignoring comp.ifs. This explains the actual device failures: constexpr-filter-00 returned [4,10,20,30,40] instead of [2,30,40,-777,-777]; constexpr-filter-02 returned [6,0,1,2,3,4,5] instead of [2,2,4,-777,-777,-777,-777]. The passing control constexpr-filter-01 returned [4,10,20,30,40], as expected when all entries qualify. The repair evaluates predicates in source order after binding each item, short-circuits on the first false predicate, and evaluates/appends the element only when every predicate succeeds. It preserves input order and unfiltered comprehensions. Predicate values are unwrapped and checked against the existing compiler condition types; runtime predicates cannot determine a compile-time tuple length. Compilation and post-repair device results are unavailable, so held-out correctness remains unverified.
